source_data.desc: You were once a typical drow, then you fell victim to the ravaging claws and teeth of a darakhul. The deadly darakhul fever almost took your life, but, when you were on the verge of succumbing, you rallied and survived. You were changed, however, in ways that even the greatest healers of your people can't fathom. But now that you are immune to darakhul fever, your commanders have a job for you.
source_data.name: Fever-Bit

traits.desc: Your long exposure to the life-sapping energies of darakhul fever has made you more resilient. You have resistance to necrotic damage, and advantage on death saving throws.

traits.desc: Your brush with death has made you more stalwart in the face of danger. You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

en.description: You were once a typical drow, then you fell victim to the ravaging claws and teeth of a darakhul. The deadly darakhul fever almost took your life, but, when you were on the verge of succumbing, you rallied and survived. You were changed, however, in ways that even the greatest healers of your people can't fathom. But now that you are immune to darakhul fever, your commanders have a job for you.
en.name: Fever-Bit

ru.description: Вы когда-то были типичным дроу, затем вы стали жертвой опустошающих когтей и зубов дарахула. Смертельная лихорадка дарахула почти забрала вашу жизнь, но, когда вы были на грани того, чтобы поддаться, вы собрались и выжили. Однако вы изменились способами, которые даже величайшие целители вашего народа не могут понять. Но теперь, когда вы невосприимчивы к лихорадке дарахула, у ваших командиров есть для вас работа.
ru.name: Укушенный лихорадкой
